description: Stable module-family control identifiers. These IDs reference module-level control families, not individual requirements or implementation status.

controls.title: Core operating policy and secure engineering
controls.verification_guidance: Review authority, secure defaults, engineering workflow and mandatory self-audit.

controls.title: Authentication, identity and sessions
controls.verification_guidance: Review credential storage, MFA, recovery, session lifecycle and authentication abuse controls.

controls.title: Authorisation, roles and tenant isolation
controls.verification_guidance: Review object/function/property authorization, ownership and tenant isolation.

controls.title: Injection, input validation and client security
controls.verification_guidance: Review injection, validation, output encoding, CSRF, SSRF and file safety.

controls.title: Network, transport and API hygiene
controls.verification_guidance: Review TLS, CORS, API limits, abuse controls and safe transport.

controls.title: Payments, webhooks and external event integrity
controls.verification_guidance: Review webhook authenticity, raw-body verification, replay, idempotency and financial invariants.

controls.title: Revenue tax and indirect-tax compliance
controls.verification_guidance: Review jurisdiction, tax classification, evidence, filing and reconciliation controls.

controls.title: Secrets, credentials and lifecycle management
controls.verification_guidance: Review secret storage, least privilege, rotation, revocation and leakage.

controls.title: Data protection, privacy and residency
controls.verification_guidance: Review data protection, privacy, residency, retention and database integrity.

controls.title: Operations, audit and incident response
controls.verification_guidance: Review environment isolation, logging, monitoring, incident response and recovery.

controls.title: AI/LLM security and governance
controls.verification_guidance: Review prompt injection, retrieval, model governance, tool boundaries and sensitive-data handling.

controls.title: CI/CD, infrastructure and software supply chain
controls.verification_guidance: Review build integrity, deployment, dependencies, infrastructure and supply chain.

controls.title: Mandatory in-line self-audit
controls.verification_guidance: Execute and record the applicable adversarial self-audit vectors.

controls.title: 13-layer security assurance model
controls.verification_guidance: Assess the complete assurance model for formal audit and release claims.

controls.title: Production evidence and reporting
controls.verification_guidance: Review evidence quality, traceability and assurance reporting.

controls.title: Audit and authorised penetration testing
controls.verification_guidance: Review audit lifecycle, test scope, authorisation and retest evidence.

controls.title: Security finding severity and release gates
controls.verification_guidance: Classify findings consistently and enforce non-waivable P0/P1 release blockers.

controls.title: Public security communication
controls.verification_guidance: Review public disclosures, security claims and incident communications.

controls.title: Financial integration and revenue release gate
controls.verification_guidance: Review financial release criteria, payment/tax evidence and reconciliation gates.

controls.title: Audit-first remediation and risk acceptance
controls.verification_guidance: Review root cause, remediation prioritisation and P2/P3-only risk acceptance.

controls.title: CORS and browser cross-origin trust boundary
controls.verification_guidance: Review origin trust, preflight and browser cross-origin enforcement.

controls.title: Agent execution contract
controls.verification_guidance: Review agent instruction integrity, scope, permissions and execution boundaries.
